optional_diagram_candidates.kind: optional block-count matrix and monotone matching diagram
optional_diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The complete double-coset invariant is the nonnegative matrix M(σ) with prescribed row and column margins, and the construction of σ_m allocates consecutive pieces A_ij to block pairs. A small generic matrix and block map would make the classification and monotone matching construction visible.
optional_diagram_candidates.content: Show a small matrix (m_ij) with row margins a_i and column margins b_j; represent each J_j as consecutive source elements mapped increasingly to the ordered union of pieces A_ij in the target I_i blocks; label M(σ)_{ij}=|σ(J_j)∩I_i| and Ψ(W_α σ W_β)=P_αP_σP_β.
optional_diagram_candidates.checks: Keep source and target blocks ordered; every cell count m_ij is nonnegative; row/column sums equal a_i,b_j; map σ_m is increasing on each J_j and σ_m^{-1} increasing on each I_i. Mark as explanatory, not a proof.

optional_diagram_candidates.kind: optional KLR strand and correspondence diagram
optional_diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The theorem identifies the diagrammatic generators e_ν, x_r and τ_r with diagonal, Chern and normalized elementary correspondence classes; its proof separately uses braid moves and adjacent repeated-reflection removal. A compact strand sketch would connect the presentation generators to the geometric classes.
optional_diagram_candidates.content: Draw a word ν as colored strands; mark e_ν as the identity strand configuration, x_r as a dot on strand r, and τ_r as the adjacent crossing correspondence, with arrows to the stated diagonal, Chern and normalized elementary classes. If showing a braid move, label both sides by the exact signed relation from the source presentation.
optional_diagram_candidates.checks: Use the exact word ordering and signed KLR relation; preserve the source normalization and orientation; distinguish a generator sketch from the proof that all relations and the algebra isomorphism hold.
